title: Hierarchical Stability and Lyapunov Conditions for Linear PDEs
summary: Unlike ordinary differential equations (ODEs), linear partial differential equations (PDEs) admit multiple non-equivalent notions of stability. This variety makes interpretation of Lyapunov stability results challenging. \blue{To simplify this interpretation, we propose a unified framework for hierarchical classification of notions of stability and Lyapunov conditions. To do this, for classically well-posed PDEs with admissible boundary conditions}, we define a fundamental state on $L_2$ corresponding to the minimal information needed to uniquely forward propagate the solution.
